name: sprited
description: Turn character references and generated frames into validated game animation SpriteSheets and GIFs.

interface.shortDescription: Build and repair game animation SpriteSheets in ChatGPT.
interface.longDescription: Prepare character animation prompts, slice generated SpriteSheets, validate motion and loops, repair weak frames, and export final GIF and PNG assets.
defaultPrompt: Use SPRITED to create an 8-frame walking animation from my character reference.
Analyze this SpriteSheet, identify weak frames, and prepare the smallest repair plan.
